title: TUF Snapshot Metadata Schema
description: JSON Schema for TUF snapshot metadata files that list version numbers and hashes of all targets metadata files

_type.description: The metadata type identifier. Always 'snapshot' for snapshot metadata.

spec_version.description: The version of the TUF specification this metadata conforms to. Should follow semantic versioning.

version.description: Version number of this snapshot metadata instance. Must be incremented for each new version.

expires.description: Expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Clients must reject metadata after this time.

meta.description: Dictionary containing metadata about targets files and delegated roles.

targets.json.description: Metadata information about the targets.json file.

version.description: Version number of the referenced metadata file.

length.description: Length of the metadata file in bytes.

hashes.description: Dictionary of cryptographic hashes for the metadata file.
